title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: We are hiring a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to protect our AWS-based platform and drive secure-by-design infrastructure. You will architect identity and access controls, harden cloud networking, and deliver infrastructure as code using Terraform. You will also lead SOC 2 compliance efforts, securing Kubernetes workloads and shaping SIEM monitoring for our cloud estate. This role blends deep AWS expertise with a passion for automating security at scale.
